name: Day Reporting Center / Sacramento County Office of Education
description: Reentry services – 52-Week Domestic Violence, academic preparation and testing, anger management, career readiness, cognitive behavior therapy, computers, community services, DUI programming, employment prep, housing assistance, life skills, medical insurance assistance, money management, parenting classes, substance abuse education, substance abuse treatment, transportation assistance and vocational training.
who_it_serves: Explicitly serves people on parole/probation or returning from incarceration (per program description)

name: Department of Rehabilitation (DOR) Woodland
description: Disability and benefits programs, job search and interview skills, job training and tools, college textbooks, disability equipment, support services (childcare or transportation) and connection to other outside agencies with support services.

name: California Department of Motor Vehicles
description: Vehicle registrations, identification cards, driver’s license, driving test, written examinations.

name: Transition Case Management Program (TCMP)
description: MediCal issues, General Transition Issues (clothing, food, services) Post-Release TCMP services occurs up to 90 days post-release. TCMP CRS are available M-F, 8am-4pm to respond to questions from Supervised Persons regarding previous Pre-Release benefit applications submitted, including status. Upon request, the TCMP CRS will also provide a Resource Guide via email to their AOR with information such as housing/shelter, County Mental Health Services, Employment Agency, Employment Development Department (EDD Unemployment), Social Security Administration (SSA), Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV), Health and Human Service Agency, General Assistance/General Relief, Food Stamps, Food Bank, clothing or other requested resources in their approved county of release.
who_it_serves: Explicitly serves people on parole/probation or returning from incarceration (per program description)
